subjects.title: MPSC Group-C Services
subjects.description: Comprehensive preparation for Maharashtra Group-C Services.

questions.q:
[Asked in MPSC State Services Prelims 2019] Read the statements and conclusions carefully.

Statements:
1. Some slippers are chairs.
2. All chairs are mats.

Conclusions:
I. Some slippers are mats.
II. All mats are chairs.
options: Only conclusion I follows.
Only conclusion II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.q:
[Asked in MPSC Combine Group B Prelims 2020] Assuming the statements to be true, decide which conclusion logically follows.

Statements:
1. All biscuits are wafers.
2. No biscuit is a candy.

Conclusions:
I. All candies are biscuits.
II. No wafer is a biscuit.
options: Only conclusion I follows.
Only conclusion II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.answer: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
